appDescription: REEVL finds apartment complexes around the car and answers with recorded real-estate transaction prices, saved homes and today's visit plan.

function.name: SEARCH_PROPERTIES
function.description: Search apartment complexes near the car's current location that match the conditions the user states.

query.description: The user's search conditions in their own words.

function.name: ANALYZE_PROPERTY
function.description: Describe one apartment complex with its recent recorded transaction prices, household count and completion year, or describe the neighborhood the car is in now with its price index change, a notable complex and local news headlines.

complexIdOrReference.description: The complex name, a reference to a complex mentioned earlier in the conversation, or a reference to the neighborhood the car is in now.

query.description: What the user wants to know about the complex.

function.name: MANAGE_VISIT_PLAN
function.description: List today's visit plan, or add or remove a complex in it, or reorder its remaining stops into the shortest straight-line route, or keep a complex in the user's saved homes; changes are made only after the user confirms.

action.description: The operation to perform on the visit plan or saved homes.

complexIdOrReference.description: The complex name or a reference to a complex mentioned earlier; not needed for listing.

confirmed.description: True only when the user has explicitly confirmed the change REEVL asked about.
